data.description: Design + UX spec for a native c11 model-config primitive across four axes (provider, model, effort, harness): saved/named configs, default vs most-recent resolution rule, session-watching (claude hook + scrapers), A-button launcher UX. Deliverable: docs/agent-config-primitive-design.md. Architect only, then stop for review.
data.title: Config Primitive: model-configuration selection primitive (design)

data.reason: Design + UX spec complete at docs/agent-config-primitive-design.md. Architect-only, awaiting operator review before implementation. Please weigh the 6 open questions in section 8 (esp. saved-config scope, the menu gesture change, most-recent persistence).

data.body: Operator interview 2026-07-20 resolved all 8 open questions + added 2 features. Decisions: (1) full launch-recipe configs w/ inherit-vs-override merge; (2) menu click=launch, pin=set default; (3) most-recent persists across relaunch; (4) codex mid-session /model = silent blind spot + subtle hint; (5) system-prompt field, 3 modes (inherit/append/replace), replace+empty = Gregorovich blank slate; (6) durable agent-launches.jsonl + rolled-up counters -> 'c11 config stats' ('87% Opus'), stores resolved axes not prompt text; (7) provider = derived prefix, model list grouped by provider; (8) enrich BonsplitNewTabMenuItem generically + offer upstream to cmux. Doc revised: docs/agent-config-primitive-design.md. Still architect-only, awaiting go-ahead to implement (v1 scope in section 9).

Picker-UX design question delegated to a Fable instance (surface:108, pane:35, workspace:14, tab 'Model Picker UX'). Brief: research every current model-selection touchpoint in c11 + design the picker interaction (shortlist in selector -> 'view all' configure view, optimized for a smooth launch/select flow), deliver a clickable local HTML prototype at docs/design-prototypes/model-picker/ + a rationale README, matched to c11 design language (New Workspace sheet + Stage 11 void/gold aesthetic). Ships independently; will flag operator when the prototype is ready. Note: installed app build lacks 'c11 launch-agent' (newer branch only), so used the in-pane claude --model fable launch pattern.

Model-picker UX prototype ready for review (picker surface of this design, per the sibling brief): docs/design-prototypes/model-picker/index.html + README.md. Two-tier flow — A-button popover (shortlist of saved recipes, click=launch / pin=set-default, recent row with non-live ⓘ hint, follow-recent toggle, inline stats headline) and a CreateWorkspaceSheet-styled configure sheet (library + inherit-aware recipe editor with provider-grouped router models, tri-mode system prompt incl. Gregorovich blank slate, stats view). Fully clickable; validated end-to-end in a c11 browser surface (surface:109, workspace:14). Deep-link scenes: #sheet #sheet-router #sheet-greg #stats. Open questions for the operator in README §4.

Reconciled the picker prototype's key finding into the design doc. Decision §8.8 REVISED: tier-1 picker is a c11-owned popover anchored to the A button, NOT bonsplit contextMenu/NSMenu enrichment — an NSMenu can't render per-row pin affordances, effort/system-prompt/cost chips, or hover states; a popover can. bonsplit's role shrinks to a generic 'agent menu requested at rect' trigger callback (still upstreamable to cmux). Tier-2 configure = SwiftUI sheet on CreateWorkspaceSheet idioms. Updated: §5 intro, §5.1, §7 (two rows), §8.8 + residual items (added prototype's open Qs: shortlist cap >8, ad-hoc recent-row identity, ⌘⇧A accelerator). Doc now links docs/design-prototypes/model-picker/. Design doc + prototype are aligned and together form the v1 contract.

Operator approved the design + picker prototype (2026-07-20, incl. cost-display feedback round). Build run started: v1 decomposed into C11-176..C11-182 (store / sys-prompt axis / stats rail / composition overlay / CLI+socket / A-button popover / Settings editor). Popover-vs-NSMenu question resolved: custom popover, no bonsplit enrichment. UI tickets hold at pr_open+needs_human for taste review.
